column1: 22376§minister§ˈmɪnɪstə(r)§The Prime Minister has promised to help the drought-stricken farmers in the northern part of the country.§首**相**已经承诺援助本国北部地区遭受旱灾袭击的农民。§
22377§combustion§kəmˈbʌstʃən§Combustion and gasification techniques are now at pilot and demonstration stages.§**燃烧**技术和气化技术现在处于试用和验证阶段。§
22378§veterinary§ˈvetnri§This zoo was closed down following a report by a veterinary inspector.§这家动物园因为**兽医**检查员的一份报告而被关闭。§
22379§plausible§ˈplɔːzəbl§The little boy could not find a plausible explanation for the breaking of the beautiful vase.§小男孩找不到任何**说得过去**的理由来解释漂亮的花瓶怎么碎了。§改例句：可数名词单数 explanation 前缺冠词，补 a
22380§elucidate§ɪˈluːsɪdeɪt§The notes in this book could help you elucidate the confusing and difficult parts.§书中的注释可以帮你**弄清楚**难懂的部分。§
22381§transient§ˈtrænziənt§In recent years, there has been a large transient population flowing into big cities.§近些年来，大量**流动**人口涌入大城市。§改例句：In recent years 要用现在完成时，there is 改为 there has been

22382§sanitation§ˌsænɪˈteɪʃn§Production enterprises of aquatic products without sanitation registration are forbidden to produce, process or store any export aquatic products.§未获得**卫生**注册登记的水产品生产企业禁止生产、加工或储存任何出境水产品。§改例句：exit 不能作定语表示「出境的」，改为 export
22383§distortion§dɪˈstɔːʃn§This novel reflects the struggle and bitterness of people in such a society which is full of distortion.§这篇小说反映出人们在一个**扭曲**的社会里的挣扎和痛苦。§
22384§altruistic§ˌæltruˈɪstɪk§Her motives for donating the money are altruistic? She is probably seeking for publicity.§她这次募捐真的是**毫无私心**吗？恐怕更多的是想为自己做宣传罢了。§
22385§climatic§klaɪˈmætɪk§The proposal of preventing global climatic changes was fiercely discussed in the meeting held in Copenhagen.§预防全球**气候**变化的提议在哥本哈根会议上引发激烈讨论。§
22386§pragmatic§præɡˈmætɪk§The company hired this young man because of his pragmatic attitude towards the problems of work.§公司雇用这个年轻人是因为他能**务实**地对待工作中的问题。§
22387§dwindle§ˈdwɪndl§The lake has dwindled to a third of its former size in the last decade because of global warming.§由于全球气候变暖，十年间，这个湖泊已经**缩减**到了原来的三分之一。§
22388§disdain§dɪsˈdeɪn§Paul disdains to join in this leader election with such ignorant persons.§保罗**不屑**于和这些无知的人一同参加领导人的竞选。§
22389§pedigree§ˈpedɪgriː§He was adopted as a child, so he had no opportunity of learning his own pedigree.§他从小被人收养，没有机会了解自己的**身世**。§
22390§constituent§kənˈstɪtʃuənt§The language which develops along with nationality's development is a national culture constituent.§随着民族的发展而发展的语言，是民族文化的**组成部分**。§

22391§impetus§ˈɪmpɪtəs§According to the insiders, real estate market's impetus first came from the effective demand for the release of China's huge population.§据业内人士分析，房地产市场的**推动力**首先来源于中国巨大人口的有效购房需求。§
22392§malleable§ˈmæliəbl§When dropped on the floor, malleable glass would bend rather than shatter into bits.§**韧性**玻璃掉在地上后，只会折弯而不会打碎。§

22393§renaissance§rɪˈneɪsns§The significance of the Renaissance lies in rediscovering the world and the human, and bringing the resurgence of politics.§**文艺复兴**的意义在于重新发现了世界，也重新发现了人，并带来了政治学的复兴。§改例句：指欧洲文艺复兴时 Renaissance 前要加 the；resurge 是动词，名词应为 resurgence
22394§incongruity§ˌɪnkənˈɡruːəti§It was such a night that sorrow may come to laugh without causing any great sense of incongruity.§这个夜晚，哀愁毫不**突兀**地转变为狂喜。§

22395§instinctual§ɪnˈstɪŋktʃuəl§No one will deny that winking is an instinctual reaction when something appears before your eyes suddenly.§没人会否认，当什么东西突然出现在眼前，眨眼是一种**本能**的反应。§改例句：wink 作可数名词单数缺冠词，改为动名词 winking

22396§scuffle§ˈskʌfl§After a scuffle in the stands, the security guards soon dispersed the crowd, and the football match returned to normal.§看台上一阵**混战**之后，保安人员快速疏散了人群，球赛得以正常进行。§改例句：subside 是不及物动词，不能接宾语，按译文「疏散」改为 dispersed
22397§treatise§ˈtriːtɪz§The teacher said our feedback helped him to improve this treatise, which ultimately helped everybody in the class.§老师说我们的反馈帮他改进了这篇**论文**，这最终也帮助了班里的每个人。§
22398§hypothetical§ˌhaɪpəˈθetɪkl§Many great discoveries are based on putting a hypothetical theory in the laboratory.§许多重大发现都是将**假设**的理论拿到实验室验证后得出的。§
22399§smother§ˈsmʌðə(r)§All the towns and settlements in the area were smothered in a coating of ash.§这一地区的所有城镇和居民区都被火山灰**覆盖**了。§
22400§excess§ɪkˈses§I am burdened with an excess of public attention.§公众的**过度**关注使我感到不堪重负。§
22401§spine§spaɪn§Twisting movements can place unusual force on your spine.§扭转动作会给**脊椎**带来不寻常的压力。§
22402§stress§stres§Bookstores now abound with manuals describing how to manage time and cope with stress.§现在书店里有很多关于如何安排时间、缓解**压力**的手册。§
22403§smooth§smuːð§The new bill had a smooth passage through Parliament.§新法案在议会得以**顺利**通过。§
22404§incur§ɪnˈkɜː(r)§Overdrafts usually incur charges, though some banks offer interest-free overdrafts to students.§尽管一些银行给学生们提供了免息透支的服务，但一般透支都会**产生**费用。§改译文：原译「要付费」括不出 incur（招致），改为「会产生费用」
22405§missile§ˈmɪsaɪl§The guidance systems didn't work and the missile couldn't hit its target.§制导系统失灵了，所以**导弹**没能命中目标。§
22406§compulsively§kəmˈpʌlsɪvli§If you do compulsively grind your teeth in your sleep, ask your dentist for a soft mouthguard.§如果你睡觉时**禁不住**磨牙，可以向牙医要一个质地柔软的护牙套。§
22407§wrap§ræp§I will wrap all of your birthday gifts.§我会把你所有的生日礼物都**包**起来。§
22408§confine§kənˈfaɪn§It's important not to confine yourself to reading on your subject.§不要**仅限于**阅读本专业的书籍，这一点很重要。§
22409§limitation§ˌlɪmɪˈteɪʃn§There is no limitation in the game, and you can use anything you want.§比赛没有什么**限制**，你可以使用任何你想用的东西。§
22410§chain§tʃeɪn§During the show he will be chained and thrown into a sealed aquarium from which he will try to escape.§在表演中他会被**用链条捆**起来，然后被扔到一个密封的养鱼缸里，他要设法从那里逃出来。§
22411§sip§sɪp§As you sip the wine, you'll find something special in it.§当你**小口啜饮**这种酒时，你会发现它的独特之处。§
22412§tedious§ˈtiːdiəs§The audience became sleepy because of the speaker's tedious story.§演讲者**冗长乏味**的故事使得听众昏昏欲睡。§改例句：became sleepy by 介词误用，改为 because of
22413§pathology§pəˈθɒlədʒi§My first class in this term is plant pathology.§这学期我的第一节课是植物**病理学**。§

22414§setting§ˈsetɪŋ§The Waikato river, the longest river in New Zealand, flows through the center of the city of Hamilton, providing a picturesque and park-like setting of riverside walks and gardens.§怀卡托河是新西兰最长的河流，流经汉密尔顿市中心，两岸的人行道和花园为人们提供了公园般美丽如画的**环境**。§
22415§extinct§ɪkˈstɪŋkt§A species becomes extinct when the last individual dies.§当最后一个个体死亡后，该物种便**灭绝**了。§
22416§aridity§əˈrɪdəti§The most challenging natural problem of Australia is aridity.§**干旱**是澳大利亚面临的最具挑战性的自然问题。§
22417§vision§ˈvɪʒn§This type of tablet may cause problems with your vision.§这类药品可能会给你带来**视力**问题。§
22418§organism§ˈɔːgənɪzəm§This insect is on a list of organisms known to be harmful.§这种昆虫属于有害**生物**。§改译文：organism 是「生物」，原译「物种」改成「生物」
22419§surveillance§sɜːˈveɪləns§The diplomat was placed under police surveillance.§这名外交官被置于警察的**监视**之下。§

22420§senior§ˈsiːniə(r)§Women who apply for jobs in the middle or senior management have a higher success rate than men, according to an employment survey.§一项就业情况调查显示，申请从事中级或**高级**管理工作的女性比申请同等职位的男性就业成功率高。§
22421§vague§veɪg§He gave a vague answer and we couldn't understand what he meant.§他的回答太**含糊**了，我们不明白他的意思。§
22422§translate§trænzˈleɪt§The name of the weapon was directly translated from Chinese.§这种武器的名字是从汉语直接**翻译**过来的。§
22423§poverty§ˈpɒvəti§In this country people were experiencing poverty, unemployment and famine.§在这个国家，人们正在经受**贫困**、失业和饥饿的煎熬。§
22424§modify§ˈmɒdɪfaɪ§The construction of the houses has to be somewhat modified from houses in most areas.§这些房屋的结构应该根据大多数地区房屋的样式稍做**修改**。§
22425§clockwise§ˈklɒkwaɪz§You should turn the key clockwise to open the door.§你应该按**顺时针方向**转动钥匙来开门。§
22426§isolate§ˈaɪsəleɪt§Reasons for higher job hunting success rates among women are difficult to isolate.§我们很难把造成女性求职成功率较高的原因**孤立**出来看。§
22427§highlight§ˈhaɪlaɪt§You'd better underline or highlight new words in this paragraph.§你最好把这个段落中的生词画线或用**高亮标出**。§
22428§moist§mɔɪst§The earthworm lives in moist and warm soil.§蚯蚓生活在**潮湿**温暖的土壤里。§
22429§threaten§ˈθretn§Soil erosion threatens the productivity of land in both rich and poor countries.§无论是富国还是穷国，土壤侵蚀都会**危及**土地的生产力。§
22430§underling§ˈʌndəlɪŋ§Many corporate managers find it difficult to measure the contribution of underlings to a firm's well-being.§许多公司的经理发现很难衡量**下属**对公司正常运转所做的贡献。§
22431§medium§ˈmiːdiəm§Mary uses the medium of poetry to make her ideas known.§玛丽使用诗歌这一**媒介**来表达思想。§改译文：原译没有和 medium（媒介）对应的词，补「这一媒介」
22432§detail§ˈdiːteɪl§I'll put up a notice with details of the restaurant and the menu.§我会张贴一份有关饭店和菜单内容的**详细**通知。§
22433§compile§kəmˈpaɪl§The daily paper is compiled at the editorial headquarters in the heart of the city.§日报是在位于市中心的编辑总部**编纂**的。§改译文：原译「完成」不是 compile（汇编，编纂）的意思，改为「编纂」
22434§induction§ɪnˈdʌkʃn§This mathematician got the result by means of induction.§这位数学家通过**归纳**得出了结果。§
22435§link§lɪŋk§Benefits and hours spent on the job are not necessarily linked.§工作所得与所付出的时间不是必然**相关**的。§
22436§foreland§ˈfɔːlənd§The south foreland is also open to visitors.§南部**前沿地**也向游客开放。§
22437§unemployment§ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt§The graph shows the unemployment rates in the U.S. and Japan between March 2013 and March 2019.§这张图表显示了从2013年3月至2019年3月六年间美国和日本的**失业**率。§
22438§option§ˈɒpʃn§To increase the output of crops per acre, a farmer's easiest option is to use fertilisers and pesticides.§为增加每英亩农作物的产量，农民最简单的**选择**是使用肥料和杀虫剂。§
22439§slogan§ˈsləʊgən§Their slogan is "Deeds not words".§他们的**口号**是“要行动不要空话”。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
22440§instinct§ˈɪnstɪŋkt§It is instinct that makes salmon swim upstream to lay eggs.§大马哈鱼洄游产卵是出于**本能**。§
22441§marsh§mɑːʃ§When they tried to cross the marsh, their cannons sank into the soft ground.§当他们试图穿过**湿地**时，他们的大炮陷进了松软的地面。§
22442§mental§ˈmentl§Health is a complete state of physical, mental and social well-being.§健康是生理、**心理**以及交际情况的一种整体良好状态。§
22443§hospitality§ˌhɒspɪˈtæləti§The hospitality of the host greatly impressed every guest.§主人的**殷勤好客**给每一位客人留下了深刻印象。§

22444§origin§ˈɒrɪdʒɪn§The origins of what is now generally known as modern architecture can be traced back to the social and technological changes of the 18th and 19th centuries.§通常意义上的现代建筑学的**起源**可以追溯到18、19世纪的社会和科技变革。§
22445§array§əˈreɪ§Corso's drink corner is a shelf with an array of bottles and glasses on it.§科尔索的酒水区是一个陈列着**许多**酒瓶和玻璃杯的架子。§

22446§remain§rɪˈmeɪn§Though rockets have been used for several hundred years, they remained a relatively minor artefact of civilisation until the twentieth century.§尽管火箭的使用已有几百年的历史，但它们**一直**被看作是人类文明中相对次要的发明，直到20世纪才发生了变化。§
22447§comprehension§ˌkɒmprɪˈhenʃn§The teacher's task of improving comprehension is made harder by influences outside the classroom.§老师提高学生**理解力**的工作因为课堂外的影响而变得更加困难。§
22448§journal§ˈdʒɜːnl§We are grateful to the author and the Asia Pacific Journal of Human Resources for allowing us to use the material.§我们感激作者及《亚太人力资源》**杂志**允许我们使用这些材料。§
